components.css: .ds-card{max-width:240px;border:1px solid var(--ink,#0F0F0B);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper,#F9EBD7);color:var(--ink,#0F0F0B)}.ds-card-link{display:block;height:100%;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-card-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink,#0F0F0B);outline-offset:4px;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--paper,#F9EBD7)}.ds-poster-fallback{aspect-ratio:2/3;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;padding:16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink,#0F0F0B)}.ds-poster-fallback>span{font:400 28px Anton,Impact,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-poster-fallback small{color:var(--muted,#585044);font:400 14px "Source Sans 3",system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-caption{padding:10px 12px;border-top:1px solid var(--ink,#0F0F0B)}.ds-caption h2{margin:0;font:400 20px/1.2 Anton,Impact,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;overflow-wrap:anywhere;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}.ds-caption p{margin:6px 0 0;font:400 14px/1.45 "Source Sans 3",system-ui,sans-serif}@media(max-width:599px){.ds-caption{padding:8px}.ds-caption h2{font-size:18px}}@media(min-width:960px) and (max-height:720px){.ds-caption p{margin-top:4px}}

components.name: Favorite selection
components.description: Paper favorite tile from ProfileForm. Artwork is square normally and 136px high on compact desktop; the selected caption remains 18/22px there. aria-pressed and the red checked corner jointly convey selection. This sample contains no external artwork.

components.name: Owned wordmark
components.description: Original typeset wordmark and CSS underline from Wordmark.tsx. The wordmark is the only slanted display treatment.

narrative.overview: The 1536 × 1024 board contains three separate narrow screens. Sign-in uses an angled opening illustration; favorites uses a cropped eye strip, three progress marks and captioned tiles; Discover uses a single feature, two mode buttons and labeled bottom navigation. The paper, ink and red dominate even the illustrated covers. This corrects an earlier description of full-color artwork as a defining feature. Treat the fictionalized cover illustrations as composition studies.
keyCharacteristics: The paper, ink and red dominate even the illustrated covers.
The lettering is visibly heavy, narrow and uppercase.
Paper surfaces, no elevated card shadows.
Decorative marks remain outside reading and control surfaces.
